description: Empirical reasoning schemas and archetypes for baseline JavaScript runtime mechanics and TypeScript type safety (U01 to U07).

archetypes.name: Defensive Primitive Sanitization & Coercion Guard
archetypes.coreConcept: Distinguishing primitive types from reference values, enforcing strict equality, and handling nullish values (null/undefined) safely without overwriting legitimate falsy values (0, false, empty string).
mentalModel: 1. Identify whether incoming properties are primitive values (number, string, boolean) or missing (null, undefined).
2. Use strict equality (===) and nullish coalescing (??) instead of logical OR (||) to preserve legitimate 0 or false values.
3. Return sanitized data transfer object conforming to the schema specification.
archetypes.governingInvariant: sanitizedValue = (inputVal !== null && inputVal !== undefined) ? inputVal : defaultValue

cognitiveTraps.name: Falsy Zero Value Overwrite
cognitiveTraps.description: Using 'val || defaultVal' overwrites valid 0 or empty string with default values.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Pass { timeoutSec: 0 }; with || default of 30, it incorrectly yields 30 instead of 0.

cognitiveTraps.name: Loose Equality Implicit Coercion
cognitiveTraps.description: Comparing with '==' causes unintended coercion between false, 0, and empty strings.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Comparing '' == 0 returns true, bypassing empty string validation.

realWorldDomains.description: Sanitizing environment variable overrides for microservice configuration.
Normalizing user settings where 0 or false are valid operational thresholds.

archetypes.name: Encapsulated Lexical Scope & Closure State Factory
archetypes.coreConcept: Creating private state enclosed within execution context boundaries, exposing controlled accessors without leaking internal data structures.
mentalModel: 1. Initialize private state variables inside the outer factory function frame.
2. Return an object interface whose methods form closures over the private state.
3. Ensure external mutation cannot compromise internal state references.
archetypes.governingInvariant: privateState accessible exclusively through returned accessor functions; outer lexical frame retained in heap

cognitiveTraps.name: Internal Reference Escape
cognitiveTraps.description: Returning a direct reference to an internal mutable array or object allows external mutation bypassing encapsulation.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Call state.getAll(); mutate returned array; internal registry is corrupted without calling add().

realWorldDomains.description: Thread-safe event counter tracking request latency buckets and hit counts.
In-memory token vault holding ephemeral credentials with controlled expiration.

archetypes.name: Immutable Collection Transformation Pipeline
archetypes.coreConcept: Processing and summarizing datasets using pure transformation pipelines (map, filter, reduce) without mutating input collections.
mentalModel: 1. Filter input records by required business status or timestamp range.
2. Map/transform matching records into normalized reporting schemas.
3. Reduce into structured aggregations (grouping by key, summing totals, computing percentiles).

cognitiveTraps.name: In-Place Array Sort Mutation
cognitiveTraps.description: Calling Array.prototype.sort() directly on input array mutates the original order unexpectedly.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Call sortOrders(orders); check original orders array order; order was permanently altered.

realWorldDomains.description: Aggregating daily settlement revenue by category with tax breakdowns.
Summarizing microservice error counts grouped by HTTP response code.

archetypes.name: DOM Event Delegation & Propagation Controller
archetypes.coreConcept: Managing dynamic UI interactions via parent delegation, accounting for event bubbling from nested child elements (e.g. icons, spans inside buttons), and preventing event propagation issues.
mentalModel: 1. Attach a single listener to the container element rather than each child row.
2. On event trigger, traverse upward using event.target.closest(selector) to match the interactive boundary.
3. Ensure clicks on nested children (icons, bold tags) trigger the correct handler with the parent dataset attributes.
archetypes.governingInvariant: delegatedTarget = event.target.closest('[data-action]'); handler executed with target dataset attributes

cognitiveTraps.name: Direct Target Assumption on Nested Elements
cognitiveTraps.description: Inspecting event.target.dataset directly instead of event.target.closest('[data-action]') fails when clicking inner <span> or <i>.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Simulate click with event.target = <span> nested inside <button data-action='delete'>; target.dataset is empty.

realWorldDomains.description: Handling row action buttons (edit, delete, view) in high-throughput virtualized data tables.
Managing interactive task card interactions across dynamic columns.

archetypes.name: Resilient Async Microtask & Promise Combinator
archetypes.coreConcept: Orchestrating concurrent asynchronous operations with partial failure tolerance, microtask coordination, and deterministic timeout aborts.
mentalModel: 1. Accept an array of asynchronous tasks and execute them concurrently.
2. Isolate failures so that individual task rejections do not abort surviving tasks.
3. Return structured settlement results partitioned into fulfilled values and rejected errors.
archetypes.governingInvariant: results.length === tasks.length; all promises settled before resolving combinator

cognitiveTraps.name: Premature Fast-Fail with Promise.all
cognitiveTraps.description: Using Promise.all for independent tasks causes a single transient failure to abort all other valid results.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: 3 tasks run; task 2 fails; results of task 1 and 3 are lost.

realWorldDomains.description: Aggregating upstream service dependency health checks with per-service latency.
Preloading critical UI assets in parallel with graceful fallbacks.

archetypes.name: Discriminated Union & State Machine Reducer
archetypes.coreConcept: Implementing strict runtime and compile-time state transitions using discriminated union action patterns and type narrowing guards, enforcing exhaustive coverage without unhandled branches.
mentalModel: 1. Define distinct states and event actions characterized by a common discriminant property (e.g. 'type' or 'status').
2. In the transition reducer, narrow action payload types based on the discriminant.
3. Reject invalid state-to-state transitions with descriptive domain errors, guaranteeing state consistency.
archetypes.governingInvariant: newState = transition(currentState, action); invalid transitions throw InvalidStateTransitionError

cognitiveTraps.name: State Mutation on Invalid Transition
cognitiveTraps.description: Permitting transition actions from incompatible states (e.g. CANCELLED -> SHIPPED) corrupts domain state integrity.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Dispatch PAY event on an already REFUNDED order; status changes to COMPLETED.

realWorldDomains.description: Managing e-commerce payment checkout flow (INITIAL -> AUTHORIZED -> CAPTURED / VOIDED).
Enforcing device firmware update lifecycle (IDLE -> DOWNLOADING -> VERIFYING -> FLASHING).

archetypes.name: Diagnostic Debugging & Minimal Reproducer Isolation
archetypes.coreConcept: Locating and remediating subtle logical bugs and boundary defects in existing code guided by reproducer test suites without causing regressions.
mentalModel: 1. Run test suite to observe exact assertion failure and reproducer input.
2. Trace variable state changes step-by-step through the defective execution path.
3. Apply targeted remediation preserving external function signature and existing behavior.
archetypes.governingInvariant: failing reproducer test turns Green; all existing baseline tests remain Green

cognitiveTraps.name: Special-Case Patching Instead of Root-Cause Fix
cognitiveTraps.description: Adding an ad-hoc if statement for the specific test case rather than fixing the underlying logical equation.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Add 'if (x === 42) return true;' passing test 1 but failing boundary test with x = 43.

realWorldDomains.description: Fixing URL query string serializer for repeated keys and special character encoding.
Fixing deep object path getter ('a.b.c') when encountering null or intermediate primitives.
